resources.string: Create a course in Courses. Choose Scheduled for calendar sessions, or Unscheduled for a topic checklist. Unscheduled courses need at least one topic. The mode cannot be changed later. Up to 10 unfinished courses can have their own colors.

Type a category or choose a suggestion. A new category is created when you save the course. The trash icon deletes a category independently of the form: canceling the form does not undo this deletion. Courses remain without a category.

Edit list opens unfinished topics as text, one topic per line. Paste, reorder or remove lines, then apply the list and save the course. Canceling the list keeps the previous draft; canceling the form discards unsaved edits. Completed topics remain outside the editor. Matching completed names block saving and show the conflicting line numbers.

Hold a saved topic to mark it complete. Hold it again to remove the mark. A short tap does nothing; scrolling cancels the gesture. Save pending list edits before using this gesture. Manual topic marks never create calendar sessions.

For a saved scheduled course, choose Configure to set weekdays and start times. End times and the final date are optional. Topics are not assigned to dates. Unscheduled courses have no calendar or reminders.

Today shows sessions for today and the next study day. After the end time, or 90 minutes after the start if no end was set, an unanswered session asks whether you studied. Choose Done and select the topics you actually finished, in any order. You may also save Done with no finished topics. Skipped does not change topic progress.

Choose a date in Calendar to see and correct session results. Bright stripes mean Done; pale stripes mean Planned or Skipped, with a cross for skipped sessions. Past unanswered sessions become Skipped on the next day. Courses without topics count completed sessions instead of showing a percentage.

After the final topic, complete the course or keep it active. Keeping it active preserves progress and stops new sessions until incomplete topics are added. Pause removes the schedule and future sessions but keeps history and the color. Completing marks remaining topics complete and releases the color. Deleting permanently removes the course and its history. These actions ask for confirmation.

Enable reminders in Settings and allow Android notifications. If Android requests permission for alarms and reminders, allow it for reminders at the exact start time. Reminders are sent only when a scheduled session starts. The question about its result stays inside the app. Declining permission does not block the tracker.
